_about: Why each term exists: the policy pack of roadmap Epic E, release 1, as E1 and E2 need it; awaiting confirmation.

PolicyRule.question: What may a role do, and what does one rule say in full? (PL1, PL4)
PolicyRule.why: The unit a reviewer approves and the bundle carries. A kind of the estate's Policy so a Decision governs it and a Document records it with the relations the estate already has. A draft until a named person activates it, since an access rule nobody signed must not compile.

Permission.question: Which permission does a rule grant or refuse? (PL1, PL4)
Permission.why: An action on a kind of resource, narrowed by a selector, as a node of its own rather than attributes of the rule: several rules permit or forbid the same permission for different roles, and a reviewer reads the permission once.

Principal.question: What may a principal do through the roles it holds? (PL6)
Principal.why: The snapshot an agent runs under is for one agent and one principal; without a node for the identity that holds the session, the intersection has nothing to intersect with. An account rather than a person, since a person has several and a service has none.

for_role.why: A rule speaks about roles and teams, the estate's own; in Cedar each is the principal of one policy.
for_role.question: What may a role do? (PL1, PL4, PL5)

of_permission.why: One permission per rule keeps a rule readable and a Cedar policy one action; a rule for two permissions is two rules.
of_permission.question: Which permission does a rule grant or refuse? (PL1, PL4)

singles_out.why: A rule that singles out resources compiles to `resource in [...]`; one that does not covers its permission's class through the selector.
singles_out.question: Who may do what on a table? (PL4, PL5)

holds_role.question: What may a principal do? (PL6)
holds_role.why: Roles are what the rules speak about; a principal reaches the rules through them.

granted_role.question: Which roles was an agent granted? (PL7)
granted_role.why: An agent's own grants bound what any principal can make it do; the agent pack's works_for says whom it serves, not what it may touch.
